test_title: PYST 11: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
A # B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the daughter of B’

A & B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A % B means ‘A is the wife of B’

If G % M # L @ P & C @ B, then how is L related to B?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given: 

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the Brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the Daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the Husband of B’.

'A % B' means 'A is the Wife of B'

**Given:- **G % M # L @ P & C @ B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e857dbc10c0448c5ace605d2f8ead76d1f72e5aa1ba7af57dd9beab93169a3.png] 

Clearly, L is the grand daughter of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Grand daughter".**
